description: This PHP source file defines the Aws\IoTAnalytics\,IoTAnalyticsClient class which extends Aws\AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS IoT Analytics service, including various operations like creating, deleting, describing, and listing resources, as well as starting and running pipelines. It also documents the available methods via doc comments.

classes.name: IoTAnalyticsClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS IoT Analytics service.
